header.description: clsMonsterAttackSim: RunSim with a fixed Rnd state per case, GetMaxDamage, resist helpers.
notes: RunSim calls Randomize with no argument; the oracle leaves the generator alone, so each case starts the Rnd sequence from inputs.rnd (24-bit LCG state, 327680 when absent) and a port must not reseed.
sCombatLog uses CR LF. Currency outputs are {cur: value*10000, s: display}.
